subject: Geografia
description_pt: Comparar modificações das paisagens nos lugares de vivência e os usos desses lugares em diferentes tempos.

components.description_pt: Identificar transformações em paisagens nos lugares de vivência dos estudantes ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Identify transformations in landscapes within students' places of lived experience over time
components.cc_component_description: Identify how wind and water erosion change the shape of land over time

components.description_pt: Comparar usos de lugares locais em diferentes períodos históricos
components.description_en: Compare uses of local places across different historical periods

components.description_pt: Analisar fatores que impulsionaram mudanças de paisagem no ambiente local dos estudantes
components.description_en: Analyze factors that drove landscape changes in students' local environment
components.cc_component_description: Identify ways human activities negatively impact land, water, air, or living things in the local environment

cc_matches.description: Communicate solutions that will reduce the impact of humans on the land, water, air, and/or other living things in the local environment.
Compare multiple solutions designed to slow or prevent wind or water from changing the shape of the land.
